comment: The whole module is monophonic per side. The detector level is the larger of the two inputs divided by 5, C7.cpp:30, so 5V counts as 0dB. In the Lmt and AdL settings the ratio is replaced by 1000, C7.cpp:65, which is why the Rto knob does nothing there. The delay is held to at most 1024 samples, C7.cpp:75, so at high sample rates the menu's 21ms cannot be reached. The In-Gain knob also scales the sidechain, C7.cpp:125.
